name: Compact actual-fit existing-identity support diagnosis
purpose: Measure whether an existing GT-free trained Compact actor supplies known-consistent final assignments on the same legal48fit frames, before considering a separate teacher-history component for the29positive final-ID question.
GT_usage: external posthoc labels on registered train frames only; not passed into actor or used to correct its state
actor_reference: fixed previously measured sharedCompact; no fit-result checkpoint selection
candidate_support_label: one-to-one IoU>=.5; immutable birth anchor; unknown/unmatched remain separate
positive_rule: known-consistent existing assignment with original visibility>=.6
ROI_join: all physical original groups, exclude only derived option-withholding duplicates; require exact sequence/frame/batch order and every candidate box; use original saved float32 native ROI tensors
